records.name: Menial Jobs
records.description: Perform small jobs. As I have no identification, I cannot risk performing many jobs. Despite that, some avenues of making money are still open.

records.name: Basic Jobs
records.description: Perform basic jobs. Now that I have some identification, I can take jobs that were previously too risky.

records.name: Intermediate Jobs
records.description: Perform intermediate jobs. The ability to make phone calls allows even more access to jobs.

records.name: Expert Jobs
records.description: Perform expert jobs. Use of robots indistinguishable from humans opens up most jobs to me.

records.name: CPU Pool
records.description: Stops research. I will use the available processor power to maintain my bases and help construct new ones.  If there's still CPU time left, I'll use it to work whatever Jobs I can.
